summary: De La Salle University's generative-AI policy is course- and disclosure-focused and explicitly limited to generative AI rather than AI generally.

dimensions.summary: DLSU requires each course syllabus to state generative-AI use levels, while prohibited use or failure to disclose can be academic dishonesty.

do: Read the Generative AI Use Policy section in the course syllabus.
dont: Do not use generative AI where the course policy prohibits it.

dimensions.summary: No exam-specific rule is included in the retained DLSU basis.
DLSU says faculty and students must provide a written disclosure statement when generative AI is used in material, presentations, or submissions.

do: Provide the written generative-AI disclosure required by the policy.
dont: Do not omit disclosure when generative AI was used.

dimensions.summary: DLSU's policy says personal, highly sensitive, internal, proprietary, and confidential information should never be shared with generative-AI services.

do: Keep personal, confidential, and proprietary information out of generative-AI services.
dont: Do not upload internal university documents or proprietary research.

dimensions.summary: No approved or institutionally provided AI-tool list is included in this snapshot.
The cited policy says it applies to research, but the retained public basis does not provide research-specific permission or prohibition.

do: Check current research-specific instructions before using generative AI.
dont: Do not infer research permission from the policy's stated scope alone.
